Copy one explicit package into the immutable managed store

Usage: larp cc skills add [OPTIONS] --name <NAME> <PATH>

Arguments:
  <PATH>  

Options:
      --json                                   Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --name <NAME>                            
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>  Refuse if the registry revision has changed
  -h, --help                                   Print help
